caption: The drawing shows two circular, ornate objects positioned side by side, each rendered in shades of gold and brown. The object on the left features a symmetrical design with a central circular boss surrounded by elaborate swirling patterns and clusters of small raised dots, with four rounded protrusions on the outer edge, each also decorated with similar dot patterns. The object on the right has a central floral motif consisting of a large, round center encircled by a ring of petals, and around the outer edge are repeated leaf or petal shapes forming a textured border. Both objects are depicted with shading to give a three-dimensional effect. Between them, there are two pairs of parallel, bracket-like lines, indicating correspondence or comparison. In the lower left corner, there is a black and white scale for reference, marked in inches with subdivisions to 1/8 inch, and the artist's name “P. Johnson” appears in the lower right corner of the drawing. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, and a thin, double-lined border frames the entire composition.
title: Rosette Mounts
